mapper.select: select count(*) from CART C INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON C.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN product_img I ON P.PRODUCT_NO = I.PRODUCT_NO where C.user_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT C.CART_NO, C.USER_ID AS userId, C.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, C.QUANTITY AS quantity, C.CDATE AS cdate, P.BRAND AS brand, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PRODUCT_SIZE AS productSize, P.PRODUCT_DETAIL AS productDetail, P.SELL_COUNT AS sellCount, P.GENDER AS gender, P.TYPE_NO AS typeNo, P.UDATE AS udate, P.QUANTITY AS productStock, P.GENDER AS productGender, PI.IMG_PATH AS imgPath, PI.IMG_NAME AS imgName, PI.IMG_ORGNAME AS imgOrgname, PI.IMG_SIZE AS imgSize, PI.IMG_ETC AS imgEtc, PI.PRODUCT_IMG_NO AS productImgNo, P.SALE_YN, P.SALE_PRICE FROM CART C INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON C.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMG_PATH, IMG_NAME, IMG_ORGNAME, IMG_SIZE, IMG_ETC, PRODUCT_IMG_NO FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMG_PATH, IMG_NAME, IMG_ORGNAME, IMG_SIZE, IMG_ETC, PRODUCT_IMG_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY PRODUCT_IMG_NO) as rn FROM PRODUCT_IMG ) WHERE rn = 1 ) PI ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE C.USER_ID = #{sessionId}

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BRAND, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.PRODUCT_SIZE, P.QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_STOCK, C.QUANTITY FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN CART C ON P.PRODUCT_NO = C.PRODUCT_NO WHERE 1=1 AND P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND C.CART_NO = #{cartNo}
SELECT * FROM PRODUCT WHERE BRAND = #{brand} AND PRODUCT_NAME LIKE #{baseProductName} || '%' AND QUANTITY > 0 ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_SIZE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CART WHERE USER_ID = #{sessionId}
